raw_snippet: sennder signs agreement to acquire C.H. Robinson’s European Surface Transportation operations, combining revenue to EUR 1.4bn
value_text: acquired C.H. Robinson European Surface Transportation (EST) operations (road freight broker / forwarder, Europe (seller USA))
note: Business-unit carve-out; terms not disclosed. Closing announced by sennder on 2025-02-03. Date: Signing date; closing announced 3 Feb 2025.
